review.notes: Full review. Sources: 68 HTT locators (all 15 sampled targets: 1.3, 1.5, 2.1-2.4, 3.4, 4.2, 6.3, 6.4, 7.1, 7.3, 7.4, 7.7, 8.1) and Berger-Moerdijk 2.5-2.6 checked against the texts; Hirschhorn, May-Ponto, Adamek-Rosicky, Hovey, Crans not readable legally. 57 supplier declarations resolved at the pins. Depcheck: 0 problems; no change outside the family folder. Findings: R01 (P2) instances of 3.3, 7.2, 7.5-7.7 planned on main by GeneralizedCohomology G2 item 1 and BordismFormalGroups F6.5 are not named in Scope and ownership; R02 (P3) routes of 5.4.1/5.4.2 do not meet the criterion of 5.3.1 as stated; R03 (P3) Summary says colimit-preserving where 5.5 and the Lean say filtered colimits; R04 (P3) redundant hypothesis hS in le_transfiniteCompositions_pushouts; R05 (P3) description misstates the deferral of LocallyPresentableCategories. Seven source issues in HTT recorded.
